_doc: During-war component config (spec v0.4). One entry per initiator->territory pair; theater defaults apply unless a pair sets 'overrides'. All values provisional until Phase 5.

middle_east_war._notes: mu = cessation of fighting (accepted offer). h = re-entry; theory: SSPE onset hazard, engine value is a lower bound (engine prices interstate war A); Phase 5 wires it. announcement_lr is used from v2b on: weak because a non-self-enforcing deal is announced without cessation (commitment problem, Powell 2006). announcement_lr: direction from theory (non-self-enforcing deals are announced without cessation, Powell 2006); MAGNITUDE 2 IS ASSUMED, not derived (ChatGPT review Oct 19).
middle_east_war._pooling_note: Oct 19 evening: pooling OFF (Adi). With two pairs the 'theater center' is just Lebanon's rate, a shortcut, not a mechanism. Revisit with >=3 pairs or an external reference class (UCDP GED). pool_on / pool_w8 logged.
middle_east_war._ceasefire_note: Oct 19 (Adi + both reviews): effect set to 0 in production; LR not identified, and the UCDP termination data oversample successful ceasefires. lr_2 / lr_4 logged as variants. Revisit with a dataset that includes failed ceasefires.

Israel->Lebanon._seed_source: Israeli strike campaign in Lebanon from Mar 2, 2026. With primary rates the seed is forgotten long before the first resolution (Sep).
Israel->Lebanon._overrides_source: pilot/priors_world.json (Israel->Lebanon, class cross_border_nonstate, frozen 2026-10-20); ACLED 2015-2025 worldwide, pooled by rule-assigned class.

Saudi Arabia->Yemen._combatants_note: Default unless Adi objects (Oct 19). Only feeds the ceasefire classifier; qualifying strikes are any on Yemeni land territory.
Saudi Arabia->Yemen._seed_source: Saudi air campaign after the Houthi maritime embargo (Jul 20). dyad_configs onset 2026-07-25 is the data-start date, not the onset.
Saudi Arabia->Yemen._day_tz_note: Rules text: 'on the specified date, Yemen Standard Time' (UTC+3).
Saudi Arabia->Yemen._overrides_source: pilot/priors_world.json (Operation Restoring Hope->Yemen, class coalition, frozen 2026-10-20); ACLED 2015-2025 worldwide, pooled by rule-assigned class.

_publish_note: Oct 19: publish=true means v2c sets the published price for this pair's single-day contracts. Set false to fall back to the engine.
